what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission reviewed the lake contractor's pretreatment survey and proposed herbicide treatment areas.
Members questioned treating areas with only native plants; the contractor defended the plan under the lake management plan.
A motion to approve the treatment plan, with some areas to be rechecked, was made and seconded; the captions do not carry the vote.
The contractor is to send the commission an updated treatment map if areas change.
A Gilchrist Street conservation easement alternative will go on the next agenda for a possible recommendation to the selectmen.
